name: Regulatory input, target and effect
description: Represent which input changes regulator state/abundance, through what route, and which target experiences activation, repression or another effect.
claim_scope: A directed relation with input, state, target, sign and condition. Enzyme/protein regulation and transcription are included; occupancy can be recorded without productive control.
distinctions: Environmental response versus direct sensing, cofactor chemistry, feedback or abundance.
Shared DNA-site class versus target-dependent activation/repression.
Reversible activity change versus altered transcription/degradation.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Motif/footprint does not specify regulatory sign.
Ligand-responsive phenotype does not establish direct sensing.
Total protein change does not establish per-molecule activity.
Assay recovery is not a measured intracellular state trajectory.
boundary: A02 carries DNA/ligand recognition specificity. A05 carries productive input-to-target effect. A06 may establish regulatory participation without resolving the full relation.

evidence.source_locator: Figures 1–4 and 7; Table 2; cluster occupancy/demand Results.
evidence.observation: Footprinted site C lacks the measured regulatory effect of A/B, while cluster state, abundance and demand comparisons resolve different regulatory inputs.
evidence.limit: Target conditions remain explicit; no intracellular state-pool reconstruction.

evidence.source_locator: Figures 1–6; relevant redox, iron-release, reporter and DNA-binding Results/Methods.
evidence.observation: PMS under anaerobic versus aerobic conditions separates cofactor-state action from cluster destruction, with distinct target-class reporter effects.
evidence.limit: Direct cofactor action is not selective PMS-pocket recognition; chamber auto-reduction is the authors’ interpretation.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Complete genomic reconstruction, dual-function results, evolutionary caveats, and relevant bioinformatics/DNA-binding/kinase methods read. Structure section not exhaustively inspected; no motif scan or assay repeated.
evidence.observation: RibK fusion makes FMN and binds DNA; FMN disrupts binding, but operator position only suggests transcriptional activation.
evidence.limit: Activation was not directly measured; no new motif scan or assay.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant Results including deletion, reporter rescue and sugar-independent DNA binding; growth/deletion/purification Methods inspected.
evidence.observation: Deletion, reporter rescue and promoter binding establish activation while maltose did not change tested EMSA binding.
evidence.limit: Maltose-use regulation does not establish direct maltose sensing.
